extracted_text:
Langchain : Chains, agents, and retrieval strategies that make up an application's cognitive architecture.

LangGraph : A library for building robust and stateful multi-actor applications with LLMs by modeling steps as edges and nodes in a graph. Integrates smoothly with LangChain, but can be used without it.

Productionization:

LangSmith: A developer platform that lets you debug, test, evaluate, and monitor chains built on any LLM framework and seamlessly integrates with LangChain.

Deployment:

LangGraph Cloud: Turn your LangGraph applications into production-ready APIs and Assistants.
diagram_summary: Architecture diagram showing LangChain ecosystem with three layers: Deployment (LangGraph Cloud - commercial), Components (Integrations - OSS, LangChain - OSS, LangGraph - OSS), and Development (LangSmith with features: Debugging, Playground, Prompt Management, Annotation, Testing, Monitoring - commercial).
